# Vendored design skills

These skills are vendored from [jakubkrehel/skills](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills), pinned at commit [`90f01412aebb0361671215be1383ca73527e3ed6`](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills/commit/90f01412aebb0361671215be1383ca73527e3ed6).

The upstream repository and these skill files are licensed under MIT. The original license is preserved in this directory. Keep each skill's upstream `SKILL.md`, supporting references, and `agents/openai.yaml` together when updating. Adapt project-specific requirements in `.agents/skills/project-guide/SKILL.md` rather than silently rewriting upstream guidance.
